name: Queernic Karaoke & Quizz
description: Queernic Karaoke & Quizz is a karaoke and quiz evening held at Bar of Soap in Porto.
longDescription:
Queernic Karaoke & Quizz takes place at Bar of Soap, located at Rua do Bolhão 132 in Porto. The session starts at 20:00 on 12 November 2026.

Admission is 4€ and the event is restricted to ages 18 and over.
